products.title: Adult Dirt Bike Helmets
products.body_html:
Exceeding Safety Standards for Superior Protection and Consistent Quality

DOT Certified Safety Protection: This dirt bike helmet meets DOT FMVSS-218 safety standards. It features a lightweight, durable ABS shell and a high-density EPS liner, delivering exceptional protection and all-day comfort for young riders.

Adjustable & Detachable Visor: The off-road helmet is equipped with an adjustable sun visor that can be angled to block sunlight and maintain clear visibility. It can also be easily removed when not needed.

Breathable & Removable Liner: Designed with a removable, washable inner liner that absorbs sweat and moisture efficiently. Easy to clean, it ensures a fresh and hygienic wearing experience.

Complete Value Package & Size Options: Includes 1 Helmet + 1 Goggle + 1 Pair of Gloves + 1 Mask. Available in XL(61-62) / XXL(63-64) sizes to fit various head circumferences, ensuring a snug, comfortable, and secure fit.
